name: Inner Flames
description: The tighter flame layer used close to the weapon. Nada Vfx rebuilds the vanilla branch at runtime and exposes it as its own configurable effect.

name: Outer Flames
description: The larger outer flame layer from Dyrnwyn's Burny rig. Nada Vfx separates it from the inner flame and flare so it can be controlled independently.

source.note: The runtime copy removes the flare and fx_Torch_Basic branches.

name: Strands
description: A trailing strand effect rebuilt from the vanilla medium health potion trail and attached to the weapon at runtime.

name: Sparks
description: The spark effect used by Himminafl, pulled from the vanilla weapon and rebuilt as an independently configurable Nada Vfx effect.

name: Flare
description: The bright flare element from Dyrnwyn's Burny rig, extracted into its own runtime branch so it can be positioned and styled separately.

name: Aura
description: A runtime shell built around the weapon's actual visual mesh and rendered with a borrowed vanilla glow material.

source.note: Nada Vfx borrows the loaded vanilla material and applies it to its own runtime shell without modifying or destroying the shared source material.

name: Electricity
description: An upcoming standalone electricity effect intended to behave like the other directly attached weapon effects rather than an Orbital.

source.note: TBD — vanilla source not added to the current runtime cache yet.

name: Orbs
description: The demister's glowing ball repurposed as a path-driven Orbital. Nada Vfx rebuilds only the visual pieces it needs rather than cloning the vanilla networked root.

name: Cores
description: The vanilla Surtling Core visual used as a path-driven Orbital, with colliders stripped from the cached runtime copy.

name: Flames
description: A flame visual pulled from the demister effect and separated into a reusable path-driven Orbital.

name: Embers
description: The ember visual from the same demister flame branch, split out so it can run independently on Nada Vfx's Orbital motion system.

name: Skulls
description: An upcoming Orbital visual planned for the same reusable path and motion system as the existing Orbital set.

source.note: TBD — vanilla source not added to the current runtime cache yet.

name: Crosses
description: An upcoming Orbital visual planned to plug into the same block-owned motion runtime instead of getting a one-off implementation.

source.note: TBD — vanilla source not added to the current runtime cache yet.
